# Simple smoke test

This file exists so the integration suite has a stable, minimal
fixture it can convert end-to-end without depending on any
optional features.

## What this document exercises

- Headings (H1, H2).
- A short paragraph with **bold** and *italic*.
- An ordered list:
  1. First item.
  2. Second item.
  3. Third item.

That's it. No bibliography, no math, no mermaid, no remote images —
those have their own fixtures.
